additional_context: FHIR-46624's final Jira comment says FHIR-53239 was opened for the terminology change. FHIR-53239 is currently Triaged and unresolved, so it was treated as a related, not-decided follow-up rather than a final applied/published decision. The current claim-careteamrole value set includes the external THO code system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/claimcareteamrole; no core CodeSystem source was found for a safe seed-scope terminology edit.
